facts.form: pullover with V-neckline, long sleeves with tubular cuffs, tubular knit bottom

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 6110 covers knitted pullovers; the tightened (tubular knit) bottom excludes heading 6109 (chapter 61 note 5) and 6105/6106 shirts

GRI 6: 6110.20 of cotton; 6110.20.20 other (not 36% or more flax); not a sweater (fine jersey knit, assumed over 9 stitches per 2 cm), not a sweatshirt or vest; men's or boys' other; not described as knit to shape, so suffix .69 (338)

rejected_alternatives.reason: sweater line (345); applies only if stitch count and construction make it a sweater (9 or fewer stitches per 2 cm)
only for knit-to-shape articles described in statistical note 6; jersey knit pullover assumed cut and sewn
chapter 61 note 5 excludes garments with a ribbed or tightened bottom from heading 6109
sweatshirt line; no fleece/napped surface described

missing_facts: Stitch count per 2 cm (sweater vs pullover) and whether the garment is knit to shape (statistical note 6).
classification.rationale: A men's knit pullover with a tubular knit bottom is excluded from 6109 by chapter 61 note 5 and falls in heading 6110; being 100% cotton, it goes to 6110.20.20. NY N297115 (in force) classified a men's cut-and-sewn 100% cotton finely knit pullover with a rib knit bottom in 6110.20.2069, men's or boys' other. Assuming this jersey pullover is not a sweater and not knit to shape, the same line applies.
